title: B9: Collapsible folder sections in RecipesListView
description: Make each Section in RecipesListView collapsible. Tapping the section header toggles that section's collapsed state. Default on first render: all sections expanded. Store collapsed section names in a @State Set<String> at the RecipesListView level (or a @StateObject-owned simple model if cleaner). State is in-memory only and survives tab switches within the same app session but does NOT persist across app launches. Section headers remain visible whether the section is collapsed or expanded. Existing search-filter behaviour (sections with no matching rows hide entirely) is preserved; collapse state for sections that DO match is retained.
acceptance_criteria: Each section header is tappable and toggles expanded/collapsed state
Default state on first render: all sections expanded
Collapsing one section does not affect collapsed state of other sections
Section headers remain visible when the section is collapsed
Collapsed state survives tab switches within the same app session
Search filtering still hides sections with no matching rows; collapse state for matching sections is preserved
State does not persist across app launches (in-memory only)

handoff_summary.completed: All acceptance criteria satisfied by existing code: tappable headers toggle per-section collapsed state via Section(isExpanded:); default expanded on first render; independent state per section; headers visible when collapsed; @State survives tab switches within session; search filtering (filteredSections) hides empty sections while preserving collapse state for matching ones; no persistence across launches.
handoff_summary.next_action: Hand off to tester agent to verify runtime behaviour of collapse/expand, search interaction, and tab-switch persistence.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used @State [String: Bool] dictionary (not @StateObject) as the spec suggested; sectionBinding helper provides safe defaulting to true for sections not yet in the dictionary, so any new folders discovered at runtime are expanded by default without requiring re-initialisation.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Tester should verify: (1) header tap collapses/expands, (2) multiple sections collapse independently, (3) search hides sections with no matches while retaining collapse state on sections that do match, (4) state survives tab switch.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Collapse state is reset when the app is relaunched — this is by design per the spec.

execution_history.summary: Collapsible section support in RecipesListView was already fully implemented.
